name: Roasted Beet Hummus with Orange Oil & Heart-Shaped Lavash Crackers

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium beet
½ orange
½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and medium dice beet. Transfer to a small baking dish, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until beet is fork-tender, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 10 minutes.
While the beets are cooling, zest orange into a small bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine. (Reserve orange for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the lavash into hearts using a small (2-inch) cookie cutter or knife. (With the cutter facing right-side up, cut a row of hearts across the top side. Flip the cutter right-side down, and cut a second row of hearts, using as much of the lavish as possible.) Place hearts in a medium bowl, drizzle with half of the orange oil, and toss to coat. Transfer hearts to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining oil for serving.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until hearts are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
When the beets have cooled, transfer to the bowl of a food processor.
Zest and juice lemon into the food processor.
Peel garlic and add to the food processor.

Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the food processor along with oil, tahini, salt, and pepper, then blend until the hummus is smooth. Add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a smooth consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (254 g) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp tahini
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer beet hummus to a serving dish and drizzle with reserved orange oil. Serve with heart crackers and enjoy!
